uvlo.leakage_max: AÇIK: guaranteed LM70880 EN leakage bound not confirmed
uvlo.policy: 20 V restart is required to claim operation across the stated 20–26 V input envelope; battery disconnect/falling threshold policy remains open.

O1.published_guaranteed_range_A: AÇIK: no guarantee for exact resistor value located; TPS25982 table values are discrete. 300 Ω gives 4.36–5.66 A across temperature; do not interpolate to 301 Ω or 604 Ω.
O1.IMON_accuracy_domain: 3 A..min(15 A, ILIM), -40..75 °C; S2E nominal ILIM is below 3 A, so gain accuracy not guaranteed at its trip.
O1.note: SC response test condition and retry/latch behavior are not equivalent to normal overload. Thermal/SOA is not contained in the behavioral model.

S2E.published_guaranteed_range_A: AÇIK: no guarantee for exact resistor value located; TPS25982 table values are discrete. 300 Ω gives 4.36–5.66 A across temperature; do not interpolate to 301 Ω or 604 Ω.
S2E.IMON_accuracy_domain: 3 A..min(15 A, ILIM), -40..75 °C; S2E nominal ILIM is below 3 A, so gain accuracy not guaranteed at its trip.
S2E.note: SC response test condition and retry/latch behavior are not equivalent to normal overload. Thermal/SOA is not contained in the behavioral model.

port_capacity_screen.screen_result: FAIL by nominal arithmetic only: summed nominal channel limits are slightly below 7.5A; actual distribution and guaranteed min/max at 301Ω/604Ω are not established.
port_capacity_screen.required_action: Measure O1/S2E loads and select RILIM values whose datasheet guaranteed minimum current limits cover the actual split with margin; do not claim 7.5A until then.

input_protection.F1_fault_current_A: AÇIK: Vbat/(Rbattery+Rcable+Rconnector+Rboard); source impedance, cable, interruption rating and I²t coordination unknown
input_protection.F1_i2t: AÇIK: selected fuse time-current curve and prospective fault current absent

TVS.limitations: 53.3 V is a pulse clamp datum at specified current; wiring ESL, surge duration/energy and actual TVS manufacturer not verified.

conduction_loss_screen.name: Q1 conduction loss at 82.5 W, 20 V, 80% efficiency
conduction_loss_screen.method_1: I²*RDS(on), 25C datasheet max used as screen

Q1.SOA: AÇIK: data sheet SOA curve must be checked against the actual fault waveform; no board thermal proof.

thermal.limitations: Board θ values are scenario assumptions only; copper area, layer stack, via field, airflow and enclosure are unknown. No junction-temperature result is certified.

routing.stackup_decision: 4 layers recommended for continuous ground return, thermal spreading, controlled power/analog separation and lower plane-path impedance. Equal sharing is a scenario only; no plane/via credit until actual connected copper and stackup are verified.

calculation.method: Existing calculate_routing_rules.py method: IPC-2221 external empirical fit k=.048,b=.44,c=.725 plus copper Ohm-law IR drop.
calculation.scope: 4-layer equal-path result uses the external-layer fit as sensitivity only; internal-plane thermal/current sharing, layout and fabrication require confirmation.
calculation.via_assumption: 0.5 A/via and 25 µm assumed plating; counts per transition cluster.
